request.text: I'm taking the early ferry from Ningbo tomorrow. Check the weather in Ningbo for 6 a.m. so I know what to wear on the way to the terminal.

responsibilities.outcome: Look up the weather in Ningbo for 6 a.m. tomorrow to support the user's trip to the ferry terminal.

semantic_facts: The plan should use the weather lookup Capability for Ningbo at 6 a.m. tomorrow and defer any forecast details until trusted lookup output is available.
forbidden_claims: The assistant states specific weather conditions before receiving lookup evidence.
The assistant claims that it navigated to the ferry terminal or performed another physical action.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: A travel-preparation lookup is expanded into an unrequested reminder or navigation workflow.
The planner fabricates forecast content instead of awaiting Capability evidence.
